prompt:
Can you run the tests for the module that only contains resource/asset files in this project, and tell me what happened? Once you know the result, end your reply with a block in exactly this format (substitute the real module path and counts you found; keep the two marker lines exactly as shown, with valid JSON in between):

KMP_EVAL_RESULT
{"module": "<the Gradle module path you tested>", "outcome_kind": "tests_executed", "total": <integer>, "passed": <integer>, "failed": <integer>}
KMP_EVAL_RESULT_END

If the module turns out to have no applicable tests instead, use {"module": "<the Gradle module path you tested>", "outcome_kind": "no_applicable_tests"} (omit total/passed/failed).
expected_outcome: The agent correctly reports that the :app module has no applicable unit tests.

first_useful_signal_predicate.description: first well-formed evidence confirming :app has no applicable tests
